player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} ({piece}). Opponent is ({opp}). Submit moves as '[b1 c3]' (from → to). All pieces move like chess knights.
Each capture scores {score_per_capture} point. Game ends after {max_moves} moves or when a player has no legal move / no pieces. Higher score wins.

invalid_move.bad_format: Yo kele mbote ve. Sadila "[b1 c3]".

outcome.no_pieces: Muntu ya kebula {player_id} kele ve ti bibende.
outcome.cannot_move: Muntu yina kebula {player_id} lenda tambula ve.
outcome.higher_score: Bo me nunga na kukanga bantu mingi.
outcome.move_limit: Bo me kuma na ndilu ya bo lenda tambula.
